# youtrack_state_bundle (Resource)

Manages an state bundle, the set of values of a custom field. The order of `values` defines the order in YouTrack.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the bundle.
- `values` (Attributes List) Values of the bundle in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the bundle.
- `value_ids` (Map of String) Database IDs of the values, keyed by name.

<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the value. Values are matched by name, so renaming a value deletes it and creates a new one. Archive values that are still used by issues instead of removing them.

Optional:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the value is archived and can no longer be selected.
- `color_id` (String) Index of the color in the YouTrack palette, from `1` to `35`. Not set means no color.
- `description` (String) Description of the value.
- `is_resolved` (Boolean) Whether issues in this state count as resolved. Only used by state bundles.
